channel.title: Collingwood Weekly
channel.description:
The week in Collingwood and the south Georgian Bay towns, every Friday morning: council and county decisions, the roads and the weather for the weekend ahead, local sport, what is on, and one local issue argued fairly both ways. Hosted by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — every story from named local sources.

item.title: Ep 2: Wasaga council approved 214 Beachwood Road homes after a flood-channel land promise.
item.description: Collingwood Weekly Wasaga council approved 214 Beachwood Road homes after a flood-channel land promise. What You Need to Know: Wasaga Beach council approved amendments for a 214-unit project on Beachwood Road after a flooding reassurance, with a large petition and environmental concerns still on the record. Collingwood had a house fire that forced three adults out, and impaired-driving charges followed local crashes. ... item.title: Ep 1: Police captured a bull moose in Collingwood and will move him north.
item.description: Collingwood Weekly Police captured a bull moose in Collingwood and will move him north. What You Need to Know: On Tuesday, police, firefighters and provincial staff tranquilized a young bull moose at Collingwood’s waterfront and loaded him for a move farther north. Simcoe County is planning a one-day controlled burn on about 5 hectares in the Nottawasaga Tract in Clearview, as early as late September. ... AI Disclosure: Mira, the host of this podcast, is an AI.
